posts.title: No sugar coating from Sumrall: Gators have to get better in a hurry
posts.excerpt: Dallas Wilson (6) gathers in a pass (UAA Photo) Ultimately, winning is what matters most not the aesthetics. The Florida Gators got their win Saturday night at The Swamp, but to call the 52-3 beatdown of the Campbell Camels anything more than expected would be sugar coating, something Jon Sumrall refused to do when he addressed the media in the south end…
